One day, after Каррен Тян finishes
training...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Wait up! Ayabeee!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Why do I have to wait? I'm out here training on my own.
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
I know! ♪ That's why I wanna run with
you!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I would prefer to run alone... I'll be
going now.
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text: Awww... She's gone...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
We're supposed to be roommates. Why
is she
always like that?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You're right. I'll try one more
time! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Ayabeee!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
What?! Why are you still following me?
If you're
just trying to play around,
then—
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text: I'm not playing around.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Oh?
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
You may not care about me... I may be
just a
roommate to you, but...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I wanna try running with you. I thought
that
maybe if I chase after you, I could
see the world
differently.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. I guess this must be a lot to
hear all of a
sudden.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I am just a bother.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
...I never said that. Do whatever you
want.
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text: Okay! I will! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I guess people's moods depend on
the day.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Hm... Maybe some other time...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: That night, in the dorm...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Huh? The lights are still on...
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text: Yaaawn... Welcome home!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I thought I'd wait up for you
since we
have the day off tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
It looks like you worked hard today. I
hope we
can talk tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: ...Thud!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Sigh... What's with you?
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
And so, Каррен Тян and Адмайр Вега
run
together until the sun goes down.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Falling asleep without a blanket...
Unbelievable.
You'll catch a cold.
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега
